name: pwnedpasswordsworker
description: A worker for api.pwnedpasswords.com to help with caching and padding.
author: Troy Hunt <troy@troyhunt.com>

scripts.build: pnpm run build:blob && pnpm run build:api
scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:blob && pnpm run deploy:api
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm run deploy:blob:prod && pnpm run deploy:api:prod
scripts.types: pnpm run types:api && pnpm run types:blob
scripts.types:api: wrangler types src/range-worker/worker-configuration.d.ts --config src/range-worker/wrangler.jsonc --config src/blob-worker/wrangler.jsonc --env stage --env-interface ApiEnv --strict-vars false
scripts.types:blob: wrangler types src/blob-worker/worker-configuration.d.ts --config src/blob-worker/wrangler.jsonc --env stage --env-interface BlobEnv --strict-vars false
